checks.name: status colour is EARNED, not capped: the graph agrees with the shipped policy, and every uncoloured role carries an overturn condition and a Product-evidence route
checks.detail: policy declares a dedicated hue for ["error"]; the graph reaches a status literal for ["error"]; uncoloured roles with no overturn condition or no evidence route: [] — and the policy states in terms that the count is not a cap: "That a hue must be EARNED, and that the evidence is a Product case rather than a taxonomy. Not the number."

checks.name: every vendored inherited artefact is byte-identical to the sealed package it came from

checks.name: the light appearance is deliberately empty, so resolving into it leaves E1’s two values UNRESOLVED and named
checks.detail: light expression group is empty; without the dark set these resolve to nothing and name what is missing: qandeel.status.error.ink, qandeel.state.disabled.ink

checks.name: the dichromacy model passes every property test that does not depend on remembering its constants
checks.detail: 26/26 — grey is a fixed point, the projections are idempotent, protan loses red luminance and deutan does not, and the tritan single-plane LIMIT is asserted rather than hidden

checks.name: DISABLED describes AVAILABILITY, not focusability: two patterns ship, they differ ONLY in focusability, and neither can activate
checks.detail: NATIVE NON-DISCOVERABLE UNAVAILABLE: focusable=false, activates=false | DISCOVERABLE UNAVAILABLE: focusable=true, activates=false — availability is constant across the patterns and focusability is not, which is the whole of the correction

checks.name: SELECTED + UNAVAILABLE is ruled AT THE CONTROL TYPE, and is not claimed globally impossible
checks.detail: 4 control types ruled individually — a chosen value in a set: REACHABLE, AND EXPRESSED; a list row that is the current destination: PRODUCT-OWNED; a persistent navigation item: NOT EXPRESSIBLE IN E1R; a button: NOT APPLICABLE — at least one is REACHABLE and none of them generalises to a Product law

checks.name: every one of the sixteen state combinations has a declared verdict and the precedence rule that produced it
checks.detail: 16 combinations, 0 missing, 0 without a verdict or a rule — 9 REACHABLE, 4 UNREACHABLE, 3 CONDITIONAL

checks.name: the composition model is TRUTHFUL: every channel the matrix shows two states writing is declared shared and carries a precedence rule
checks.detail: 5 visual channels reconciled against the matrix; 1 of them written by more than one state. THE WITHDRAWN CLAIM IS FALSE BY THIS DOCUMENT’S OWN CONTENT, which is the point: the expression was always right and the explanation was not

checks.name: no shipped Product-contract statement caps the number of status hues, and the policy states the route out
checks.detail: 13 product-contract statements, 0 of them a cap on the number of status hues; the policy names a Product-evidence route out and still forbids a generic traffic-light palette

checks.name: LIVING BRASS IS STATE-INVARIANT IN APPEARANCE: no rule in the shipping stylesheet repaints, dims or filters a Brass-bearing element under a state selector
checks.detail: 72 rules parsed out of the stylesheet the proof actually serves; 15 of them carry a state selector, and none touches the identity material or applies opacity or a filter

checks.name: the proof holds no colour the token tree does not know about
checks.detail: tools/e1-scene.mjs and tools/e1-boards.mjs contain no hex literal at all — every colour arrives through resolveAll(). I-08B3.1-D0 painted its chrome from constants it declared itself and inherited the WRONG COVERAGE POLICY while doing it.

checks.detail: 12 rendered boards; the Arabic fingerprint is 163.53px against a serif fallback of 102.38px

checks.detail: 12 boards measured their own clipping containers; 0 overflowing

checks.detail: greyscale: 0 chromatic pixels, 199 distinct greys (the colour original has 2705 colours and 51659 chromatic pixels)

checks.name: the dichromacy boards are derived from the raster, not from a second render
checks.detail: both declare derivedFrom review/board/b10-integrated-screen.png

checks.name: the behavioural focus and tab-ring obligations all hold under real key events
checks.detail: 15/15 obligations

checks.name: the focus indicator a REAL Tab key produces is the token’s, not the browser’s default
the two availability patterns behave as specified under real keys: the native one is skipped, the discoverable one is REACHED, and neither activates
checks.detail: MET — a NATIVE NON-DISCOVERABLE unavailable control is skipped by the tab ring | MET — a DISCOVERABLE unavailable control REMAINS REACHABLE by the tab ring | MET — a DISCOVERABLE unavailable control CANNOT be activated by the same key | MET — an AVAILABLE control activates under a real Enter key

probes.detail: qandeel.state.pressed.ink -> qandeel.illumination.core -> qandeel.expression.illumination.core is rejected by the chain rule — and note it composites to #2f2e2c, chroma 0.00383, which a chroma ceiling would have WAVED THROUGH

probes.detail: Material 3 dark error #f2b8b5: 3 floors unmet — protan: dEok from LIGHT-low 0.0419 < 0.051294338032078474; deutan: dEok from PRIMARY 0.0406 < 0.051294338032078474; deutan: dEok from LIGHT-low 0.0181 < 0.051294338032078474  ||  Apple systemRed dark #ff453a: 2 floors unmet — protan: contrast on WORLD 3.7436 < 4.5; protan: contrast on SURFACE 3.4934 < 4.5  — the floors are specific to THIS palette, not a generic bar, which is why E1 derived a value instead of adopting one

probes.name: the C1R statement, which is about the Brass MARK and is not measured here
probes.detail: C1R: "a disabled item whose mark is at full material strength does not look disabled at a glance". E1 resolves it by ruling the case out of the product, not by measurement — and says so.

probes.name: a corrupted vendored copy
probes.detail: one trailing byte changes the digest, and the check compares digests

probes.name: the dark values copied into the light set — the corruption an implementer actually commits, because "it looks fine"
probes.detail: a light set carrying #fe907e would be a light-mode error colour invented by accident; every floor that produced it is a statement about a NEAR-BLACK ground

probes.name: the tritan limit, asserted as a check rather than discovered by a reviewer
probes.detail: moved 0.00001; tritan is EXCLUDED from every derived floor

probes.name: I-08B3.1-E1’s own frozen absolute, fed back in: a single pattern in which unavailable always means unfocusable
probes.detail: one pattern, focusable=false for every unavailable control — this is exactly what E1 froze, and the check rejects it. W3C APG: screen reader users are far less likely to discover disabled elements that are not focusable, because moving focus is one of their primary methods of discovery

probes.name: the combination declared impossible everywhere at once, with no control type named
probes.detail: a single blanket row with no proof is rejected on three counts at once: too few control types, no proof, and a global claim

probes.name: a combination left undefined — the gap the old model hid by declaring one of them impossible
probes.detail: removing focus+disabled leaves ["focus+disabled"] undefined, and the check fails — which is the state I-08B3.1-E1 shipped in, with that combination recorded as "cannot occur"

probes.name: the ownership table asserting exclusivity the matrix contradicts — the exact shape of the withdrawn claim
probes.detail: the shipped matrix has ["selected","disabled"] writing the INK channel; a model declaring only ["selected"] is rejected. This is not a hypothetical: it is what the package shipped, stated as a frozen Product contract

probes.name: the cap sentence I-08B3.1-E1 actually froze, put back into the shipped contract list
probes.detail: restoring E1’s statement 9 makes this check fail — the cap is detected in the token document that ships, not in a guard’s prose

probes.name: the rule I-08B3.1-E1 SHIPPED — the navigation icon repainted to the unavailable ink when the item became unavailable
probes.detail: both are caught: .navitem[data-state~="disabled"] .ic and .ctl[data-state~="disabled"]. The first is not invented — it was in the stylesheet for the whole of E1, two packages after the material’s state-invariance was frozen, because a universal law had made it unreachable and therefore unexamined

probes.name: a scene holding one hex of its own
probes.detail: even a literal that happens to be CORRECT today is rejected: it would drift the moment anything upstream moved, and it is the same category of claim D0 made

probes.name: a board rendered without the font
probes.detail: the page measures its own fingerprint against the serif fallback; equal widths mean every glyph is a fallback and the render exits non-zero

probes.name: the guard’s own history
probes.detail: this guard was added AFTER an over-full screen squeezed three panels without looking broken, and its first version measured the children instead of the container that clips them, so it reported 0 while the last panel was being cut off

probes.name: a saturation-slider "greyscale" instead of the WCAG transform
probes.detail: the transform is WCAG relative luminance applied to the PIXELS Chrome drew. Re-rendering the scene with desaturated tokens would only prove that a different scene looks different.

probes.name: a dichromacy board with no stated source
probes.detail: the check reads derivedFrom and fails when it is absent

probes.name: the two behavioural probes, neither of them invented
probes.detail: disabled-paint-without-the-attribute / outline-removed-with-no-replacement / discoverable-unavailable-that-still-activates / only-the-native-pattern-styled / the-override-taking-the-record-too — both are ordinary implementer mistakes, and both are rejected

probes.name: the defect this check actually caught
probes.detail: an earlier build styled only [data-state~="focus"], so every STILL painted a ring the real focus state never produced and the keyboard got Chrome’s 1px default outline. No still could have seen it.

probes.name: the three behavioural probes E1 could not have written, because it had ruled the pattern out of existence
probes.detail: FIRED discoverable-unavailable-that-still-activates · FIRED only-the-native-pattern-styled · FIRED the-override-taking-the-record-too — the first is the ordinary aria-disabled mistake: reachable, painted unavailable, fully operable
